description: This file defines the I18NTranslation entity class within the OrangeHRM project. It represents a translation entry for internationalization (i18n), mapping translation strings to specific languages and storing metadata such as whether the translation is customized and last modified timestamp.

classes.name: I18NTranslation
classes.description: Entity class representing a translation record in the internationalization system, linked to language and string entities, including metadata such as modification time and customization flag.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the translation record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the translation record.

methods.name: getLangString
methods.description: Retrieves the associated language string entity.

methods.name: setLangString
methods.description: Associates a language string entity with this translation.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves the language entity associated with this translation.

methods.name: setLanguage
methods.description: Associates a language entity with this translation.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the translation value, which may be null if not set.

methods.name: isCustomized
methods.description: Checks if this translation has been customized.

methods.name: getModifiedAt
methods.description: Retrieves the timestamp of the last modification.

methods.name: setModifiedAt
methods.description: Sets the timestamp of the last modification.
